mentions.name: Sports Similarity Explorer
mentions.description: A sports data site that lets you see which of today's games are most similar to games in the sport's history, with clickable detail views for individual games. It also includes the 'Sports Zodiac' and a 'Play the Years' timeline view of how the years go by, where eras like the war years, lockouts, and the pandemic stand out clearly in the data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I like sports! I like data! Combine!

This lets you see what the games on today are most similar to in the history of the sport. Click into one and see.

Also, the Sports Zodiac.
mentions.author: rheffern
